description: Use when a crypto service sends to or receives from a self-hosted wallet and must document its checks (EU AMLR, Travel Rule files): screens the wallet against OFAC-listed addresses, the claimed owner against EU, UN, UK and US sanctions and PEP, and checks the company register for businesses. Returns no_hits, review or block_review with list versions and a signed receipt. Input: wallet, owner, optional owner_type, birth_year, country. Costs 0.02 USDC via x402, or 10 credits of a Factline API key. The first 5 paid-tool calls a day are free, no payment or key needed.

owner.description: Person or company that claims the wallet
